title: OfficePrism: Benchmarking Agents on Single-Domain Operations Across Enterprise Business Functions
abstract: arXiv:2611.22262v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Broad workplace scores can mix competence within one business function with the extra cost of coordinating across functions and systems, making failures hard to localize. OfficePrism evaluates this prerequisite through 420 single-domain enterprise tasks spanning seven business functions under shared, benchmark-defined L1--L3 task-structure levels. Each task runs in a fresh environment combining a shared synthetic organization with one function-specific domain and yped state access. Our pipeline uses grounded records, business rules, and tool schemas to jointly construct a Chinese-language ticket, a hidden executable reference witness, and an expected response, followed by automated filtering and human curation. The same task set is evaluated through full-schema and search-and-dispatch packages. translated_title: OfficePrism：面向企业业务职能单域操作的智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 宽泛的职场能力评分可能将单一业务职能内的胜任能力与跨职能、跨系统协调的额外成本混为一谈，导致失败难以定位。OfficePrism 通过 420 个涵盖七大业务职能的单域企业任务，在统一的、由基准定义的 L1–L3 任务结构层级下评估这一前提。每个任务都在一个全新的环境中运行，该环境由一个共享的合成组织与一个特定职能领域及类型化状态访问组合而成。我们的流水线利用有据可依的记录、业务规则和工具模式，联合构建中文工单、隐藏的可执行参考见证以及预期响应，随后进行自动过滤和人工筛选。同一任务集通过完整模式工具包和搜索-分发工具包两种方式进行评估。在 124 种模型-框架-工具包配置中，每个案例的自然语言与数据库联合通过率介于 22.6% 至 76.4% 之间。
tldr: 该论文提出 OfficePrism 基准，通过 420 个覆盖七大企业业务职能的单域任务（结合中文工单、可执行参考见证及自动与人工筛选流程），在 124 种模型-框架-工具包配置下系统评估智能体，发现其自然语言与数据库联合通过率仅为 22.6%–76.4%。
en_tdlr: OfficePrism introduces a benchmark of 420 single-domain enterprise tasks spanning seven business functions, revealing that agents achieve only 22.6%–76.4% joint natural-language-and-database pass rates across 124 model-harness-package configurations.
